summary: Temporary danger area EGD098E at EGTT, activated for drone flights beyond visual line of sight; ground level to 2500 feet, 12 nautical miles radius, 0000-1700.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD098E ACTIVATED. AIP SUP 109/2026
REFERS. BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI
THE TDA. A SPECIAL USE AIRSPACE ACTIVITY INFORMATION SERVICE
(SUAAIS) WILL BE AVBL FM EITHER LONDON INFO ON FREQ 124.600MHZ
(OPR H24) OR FM LYDD ATC ON CH 120.705 LYDD APPROACH DURING THE
HR OF WATCH. AR-2023-11556/92.
